baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "mimma yakburu fi sudurikum" attaches magnitude to what becomes great in the hearers' breasts, while "khalqan" keeps even that extreme inside createdness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hypothetical escalation does not search for a substance outside creative power. It exposes a scale generated in the interior: an imagined material becomes prohibitive because the breast magnifies it, although creation remains measured and originated.

activation_trace.role: The image of measuring a thing supplies the bounded created category against which imagined impossibility is tested.
Magnifying something in the breast literally locates the scale of the obstacle in the hearers' appraisal.
The interior source from which actions issue makes the magnified objection a generative posture, not a neutral material fact.

changed_reading.before: The challenge merely asks the skeptics to name an objectively harder substance.
changed_reading.after: The challenge relocates impossibility into what they themselves magnify inwardly; even their maximal counterexample remains a measured creation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "Who will restore us?" is answered by the one who opened their existence the first time, and the exchange closes by bringing the event temporally near.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return is presented as a reversible path already demonstrated by origination. The first occurrence is both a beginning and, through the split branch of counting recurrence and the branch of outcome, a template whose trajectory can be run to its return.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure and repetition after a beginning supplies the explicit restoration path.
The split mapped image of time being counted and recurring adds a temporal cycle to the restoration.
Origination and inception identify the operative power already evidenced in the addressees.
The branch in which a thing returns to its outcome lets "first" carry an endpoint as well as a beginning.
A bounded occurrence in time makes the first event a repeatable temporal instance rather than an inaccessible absolute.
Temporal approach converts the demonstrated return-path into an impending rather than merely possible event.

changed_reading.before: First creation is only an analogy offered as evidence for a second creation.
changed_reading.after: First origination is an operative return-path: beginning, recurrence, outcome, and approaching time are folded into one mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Four speech turns surround two shifting questions, while the interlocutors direct a head movement toward the speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passage stages a negotiation rather than two isolated requests for information. Once agency is answered by first origination, resistance migrates to timing; the head movement bodily marks that migration, and the second answer converts delay into proximity.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair organizes the repeated sayings as an adversarial exchange whose objection keeps changing form.
Speech functioning as conjecture marks the questions as speculative resistance rather than straightforward inquiry.
The literal head supplies the bodily surface on which the unresolved objection becomes visible.
Approaching time answers the migrated timing objection without accepting its premise of remoteness.

changed_reading.before: The verse records a question about agency followed by a question about date.
changed_reading.after: It exposes a moving resistance: when the agent-question is closed, disbelief shifts into timing and is answered by nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The candidate materials of 17:51 enter a context in which every thing already performs praise although the hearers do not comprehend it. Stone, iron, or a still greater creation therefore cannot function as mute counterexamples to restoration; their apparent muteness diagnoses limited reception.

activation_trace.role: Created existence keeps every proposed material within the same field of origination.
A thing's indication functioning as speech permits material existence itself to contribute a response.
Repeated worshipful praise supplies the active response attributed across the created field.
The unrestricted knowable thing extends that response to every material candidate later proposed.
Negated understanding locates silence in the hearers' failed comprehension rather than in created things.

structural_cues: 17:44 distributes praise across heavens, earth, and every thing before denying the audience comprehension.
17:51 answers human speech while escalating through imagined kinds of creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal praise and failed comprehension; I infer that the materials proposed around 17:51 remain expressive participants rather than mute counterexamples. A live alternative is that 17:44 supplies only a general cosmological backdrop.

changed_reading.before: The skeptics can imagine an inert substance whose nature defeats reanimation.
changed_reading.after: Their supposedly inert counterexamples already participate in an uncomprehended created response, so muteness cannot establish impossibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward magnification of 17:51 becomes one station in a bodily route of refusal: barrier, covered hearts, weighted ears, turned backs, magnifying breasts, and shaking heads. The objection is produced and displayed by an enclosed perceptual posture.

activation_trace.role: The action-producing interior is the focus point where the earlier perceptual closure becomes a magnified objection.
The literal head makes the inward refusal externally legible as bodily response.
Blocked access supplies the outer boundary of the refusal mechanism.
What is enclosed in the self supplies the concealed interior layer through which the message is filtered.
Heaviness in the ear blocks reception before the objection is articulated.
Turning the back extends perceptual closure into overt bodily withdrawal.

structural_cues: The context moves through barrier, heart, ear, and back before 17:51 names breast and head.
The branchless head-shaking verb in 17:51 links inward appraisal to visible motion without requiring an invented citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of blocked organs and turned bodies; I infer a causal route from failed reception to inward magnification and then head gesture. The live alternative is a looser accumulation of separate refusal images rather than one bodily circuit.

changed_reading.before: What grows great in their breasts is an isolated intellectual estimate of material difficulty.
changed_reading.after: The estimate is generated within an embodied enclosure that blocks reception, magnifies the obstacle, and discharges refusal through the head.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context lays out disintegration, arousal from stillness, newness after severance, created form, stone, and iron. The focus answer turns these from rival substances into traversable states: what can be cut, stilled, hardened, measured, and first opened can be returned.

activation_trace.role: Measurement holds fragmented and hardened forms within one ordered created process.
Return after departure provides the directional reversal across material states.
Opening and splitting supply the transition by which a closed or hard state need not remain terminal.
Pulverization and debris supply the disintegrated endpoint that the skeptics treat as irreversible.
Stirring what is still from its repose supplies the reverse motion out of apparent inertness.
Newness arising after cutting directly joins severance to renewed state.
The requested new creation remains an act of origination rather than a material exception.
Solid stone supplies one extreme state of resistance.
Iron and resistant hardness supply the second extreme without escaping the state cycle.

structural_cues: 17:49 moves from bones and debris to being raised as a new creation; 17:50 then escalates to stone and iron; 17:51 generalizes beyond both.
The reply changes the axis from present material condition to the agency that initiated the first condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fragmentation, stillness, renewal, stone, iron, measurement, opening, and return; I infer directional transitions among those states under one originating agency. The alternative is that the materials are only escalating examples with no process model.

changed_reading.before: Bones, debris, stone, and iron are separate objections ranked by physical difficulty.
changed_reading.after: They are phases in a reversible material process, and the answer identifies origination rather than hardness as the controlling variable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts the focus dialogue into the event it debates: the one who is asked about calls, the questioners answer, and their experienced interval contracts to little. Nearness is therefore enacted as call-response and retrospective temporal compression, not supplied as a calendar date.

activation_trace.role: The negotiated speech in the focus ayah establishes the dialogue that the next ayah turns performative.
Restoration supplies the event realized by the ensuing summons.
Temporal approach is re-expressed as the brevity perceived once the response occurs.
The spoken summons supplies the initiating action that performs the promised restoration.
Answering speech completes the call-response circuit with the formerly questioning hearers.
Duration in a place supplies the interval that is retrospectively reassessed.
Littleness contracts the apparently long wait at the moment of response.

structural_cues: 17:51 ends with an answer about nearness; 17:52 immediately begins with the day of summons and response.
The speakers who ask "when?" become the respondents who estimate that they remained only a little.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a question-answer exchange followed by divine call, human response, and perceived brevity; I infer that 17:52 enacts the mechanism promised in 17:51. The alternative is a simple chronological sequel without deliberate speech-role reversal.

changed_reading.before: "Perhaps it will be near" gives an indefinite estimate of future timing.
changed_reading.after: Nearness is experiential and performative: a summons collapses the debate into response, and the elapsed interval then appears little.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between powerless invoked figures and seekers of a means to their Lord gives the focus ending a second axis. "Near" remains temporal, but it also resonates with relational approach: restoration returns creatures to the originating one while every alleged intermediary is itself seeking which is nearer.

activation_trace.role: The explicit approach of time anchors the primary temporal reading.
Inability to lift what covers or afflicts removes the invoked figures from controlling the return.
Inability to transform a condition reinforces the agency distinction established by first origination.
Active seeking supplies movement toward the Lord rather than autonomous power in the seekers.
The heart's expectation of what is hoped for gives relational approach an affective orientation.
Nearness opposed to distance supplies the relational counterpart to the focus ayah's temporal nearness.

structural_cues: 17:51 answers "who restores us" with the originator and ends on temporal nearness.
17:56-57 denies transformative control to invoked others and describes those very figures as seeking which is nearer to their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal nearness in 17:51 and relational nearness amid seeking in 17:57; I infer deliberate resonance between the two axes. The materially live alternative keeps "near" in 17:51 strictly temporal.

changed_reading.before: Nearness in 17:51 concerns only how soon the event may occur.
changed_reading.after: Temporal approach also opens onto relational approach: the return is near in time and directs every dependent claimant toward the sole originating agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context frames 17:51 with magnitude: an earlier saying is appraised as enormous, signs warn and test, yet warning increases transgression until it is called great. The focus breast is the conversion point in this feedback loop, where disclosure can be inwardly enlarged into an objection and then outwardly enlarged into conduct.

activation_trace.role: Magnification in the breast names the internal amplification stage of the loop.
The source from which acts issue links inward amplification to later outward transgression.
Appraisal as overwhelming or awe-inducing introduces magnified speech at the opening edge of the context.
Visible signs supply disclosure that should interrupt the objection but instead enters the feedback loop.
Warning by inducing fear supplies the intended pressure exerted by the signs.
Testing a person as metal is tested supplies the transformation point at which disclosure reveals response.
Increase and growth provide the feedback arrow from warning to intensified refusal.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the outward behavior produced by the amplification.
Great magnitude at the context's closing edge displays the enlarged behavioral output of what grew inwardly.

structural_cues: The window opens with "a tremendous saying," places "what grows great in your breasts" at 17:51, and closes with "great transgression."
17:59-60 moves from visible signs and warning through testing to increase rather than correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the magnitude frame and the sequence sign, warning, test, increase, and great transgression; I infer that inward magnification is the causal conversion point. An alternative is that the repeated magnitude language is rhetorical framing without a single feedback mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The great thing in their breasts is simply the largest material counterexample they can imagine.
changed_reading.after: It is also an amplification process: warning enters the interior as a test, becomes a magnified objection, and can emerge as still greater transgression.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the form-distant q-l-l target mapped from the repeated q-w-l occurrence, so it must not replace the ordinary speech reading. It remains anchored because the focus ayah repeats that occurrence around an explicit head movement; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary acoustic-bodily resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The four q-w-l occurrences alternate around the branchless head-shaking verb and the literal heads.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped image of disturbance and motion lets repeated speech resonate as bodily destabilization.
The literal head gives the exploratory disturbance a visible bodily carrier.

changed_reading.before: Speech and head-shaking are separate verbal and gestural details.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the repeated speech exchange generates an instability that reverberates into the moving head.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-return, tooth-emergence, and impending-birth branches are remote organic images rather than direct glosses of the focus forms. They remain anchored to three explicit focus roots and converge on latent return becoming imminent; downstream prose should label the model as a material analogy, not an asserted lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "Fatarakum," "asa," and "qariban" can jointly carry emergence, hoped-for return, and an approaching birth around the explicit restoration question.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure supplies the shared directional core of the organic analogy.
A tooth breaking into emergence supplies a concrete image of latent form crossing a surface.
Hope for milk to return after interruption supplies recoverable capacity rather than creation from inert absence.
Impending birth supplies nearness as pressure toward manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Restoration is imagined only as external reconstruction of dead material.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also resembles latent capacity returning and pressing toward emergence, like renewed lactation, a breaking tooth, or near birth.

strongest_changes: The material challenge shifts from ranking substances to traversing reversible states under the agency of first origination.
The next ayah performs nearness as a call-response event that retrospectively contracts elapsed time.
Nearness acquires a relational resonance when the allegedly powerful are shown seeking which is nearer to their Lord.
The surrounding sequence turns inward magnification into a feedback loop from warning through testing to increased transgression.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah acts as a hinge: created matter is already responsive though unheard, perceptual enclosure converts evidence into inward scale, and the same scale links the context's tremendous speech to its closing great transgression.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal unity of the barrier-heart-ear-back-breast-head route is inferred rather than explicitly stated.
The relational resonance of "near" may be secondary to its plain temporal force.
The unstable-speech and organic-latency outliers depend on deliberately remote branch activations and require explicit qualification.
